html:
Namibia is a dry country on the Atlantic coast of southern Africa, with its capital at Windhoek. It was a German colony, then ruled by South Africa, and became independent in 1990.

The San, Nama and Damara had lived there for a very long time; Bantu-speaking Herero and Ovambo arrived later. Germany claimed the land in 1884 as German South West Africa. When the Herero and Nama rose against land seizures, German troops answered with the Herero and Nama genocide of 1904 to 1908. Diamonds found in 1908 built towns such as Kolmanskop.

  • 1915: the Union of South Africa conquered it.
  • 1920: a League of Nations mandate under South Africa, which later imposed apartheid.
  • 1966: the United Nations ended the mandate; South Africa stayed. SWAPO began an armed struggle.
  • 1990: independence, with Sam Nujoma as president.
sum: Namibia is a dry country on the Atlantic coast of southern Africa, with its capital at Windhoek. It was a German colony, then ruled by South Africa, and became independent in 1990.
